verdict.rationale: Justworks has a native Xero integration. It maps each pay type to Chart of Accounts lines, with department, office and employee overrides, and syncs payroll invoices manually or automatically the day after processing. Payroll data can also be reviewed in an Analytics Custom Payroll Report. However, nothing shows an API an agent could call: the OpenAPI probes all returned 404 and llms.txt is absent. Export of the custom report is only implied, so agent-driven pull and reconciliation would need workarounds. Missing for 10: a documented payroll/journal data API, an explicit report export format (CSV/journal entries), any ledger targets beyond Xero, agent-friendly docs (llms.txt/OpenAPI), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
